SELECT s.format,
 count(distinct f.receipt_id) AS transactions,
 round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(distinct f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_eur_ex_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE staff_purchase_flag)
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
